listing.name: Advanced V.G. 2 — agvg2-recomp (elprogramadorloco-arch)
listing.summary: Research project. Native controls/runtime described; full campaign not established. Upstream statements only; not Portcove runtime/gameplay verification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japan SLPM-87226 CUE and all referenced tracks. The documented data size is 573819792 bytes, with MD5 ce5f264deab37af49ff07ecf562a67ab. You retain ownership of the original files; Portcove has not downloaded or run the game files or player for this guide.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s run.bat instructions. It checks your own game data, downloads pinned portable build tools, translates the game code and compiles a local executable in out. Complete this setup with the project’s tools; Portcove does not install this player or confirm the resulting game.
